bends.note: Front turns from NW-SE diagonal to nearly east-west (east of here runs ESE to sheet 2)
Mill bends at the Front/2nd junction: 60 ft wide running SW to the river, 50 ft wide running north (NNE) toward 3rd

ends.note: ends at Ohio River bank at the left sheet margin
dead end at rear of lots fronting W. Front (726-730 W. Front)

notes: Cutter Street is printed 'CUTTER (PARK)'; sheet 9 labels the same street south of W. 2nd 'PARK ST.' and the key map calls it Park. Mill Street north of W. 2nd is 50 ft (label on this sheet top), confirmed as Mill on sheet 9. W. 2nd ends at Mill; the open ground west of Mill north of Front is railroad curve, not street. W. Front centerline carries a single track line. Scale 3.43 px/ft from scale bar.
